text:
Your landing page says "Contact us for a quote".

Your visitor wants to know: "How much will it cost ME?"

That gap is where most leads die.

A calculator closes it:
→ Visitor types their own numbers
→ Sees a real answer in 10 seconds
→ Trusts you more than the page that hid the price
→ Leaves their WhatsApp to get the detailed quote

I call this calculator-led marketing.

7 slides on how it works 👇
